description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search results related to internationalization languages within the HRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and provides properties for filtering enabled only languages and added only languages, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering language search results based on 'enabled' and 'added' status, with sortable fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter with default sort field 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEnabledOnly
methods.description: Returns the value indicating whether only enabled languages are to be filtered.

methods.name: setEnabledOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only enabled languages if true.

methods.name: getAddedOnly
methods.description: Returns the value indicating whether only added languages are to be filtered.

methods.name: setAddedOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only added languages if true.
